checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The puppy has a stout, compact build typical of toy spaniels. The back appears short relative to the leg length.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front legs are straight and appear delicate (fine bone). There is some feathering on the forelegs. Hindquarters are partially obscured but seem consistent.

The subject is stationary (sitting), so gait cannot be evaluated.
